cd /work; cat > plot.R <<'EOF'
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggtime); library(ggplot2); library(tsibble); library(readr)
  library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(scales)
})
url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/6753376ef104727ef0ca3e3db6f2ca580c0d5a7b/data/2026/2026-03-31/ocean_temperature.csv"
raw <- read_csv(url, show_col_types = FALSE)

depths <- sort(unique(raw$sensor_depth_at_low_tide_m))
monthly <- raw |>
  filter(!is.na(mean_temperature_degree_c)) |>
  mutate(month = yearmonth(date)) |>
  group_by(depth = sensor_depth_at_low_tide_m, month) |>
  summarise(temp = mean(mean_temperature_degree_c), .groups = "drop") |>
  as_tsibble(key = depth, index = month) |>
  # make every depth span the full record; missing months become explicit NA
  fill_gaps(.full = TRUE) |>
  mutate(depth_f = factor(paste(depth, "m"), levels = paste(depths, "m")))

rng <- range(monthly$month)
# summary for caption: computed from data
seas <- monthly |> as_tibble() |> filter(!is.na(temp)) |>
  group_by(depth) |> summarise(amp = diff(range(temp)))
shallow <- seas$amp[seas$depth == min(depths)]
deep <- seas$amp[seas$depth == max(depths)]

p <- ggplot(monthly, aes(x = month, y = depth_f, fill = temp)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev, name = "Sensor depth at low tide") +
  scale_x_yearmonth(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y",
                    expand = expansion(0), name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", na.value = "grey92",
                       name = "Monthly mean\ntemperature (°C)") +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("Monthly mean water temperature by depth, Birchy Head, Nova Scotia (%s – %s)",
                    format(rng[1]), format(rng[2])),
    subtitle = "Each cell = mean of daily means for that month and depth; light grey = no data that month",
    caption = paste0(
      "Shallow water warms strongly every summer and the seasonal swing fades with depth (range of monthly means: ",
      sprintf("%.1f °C at %d m vs %.1f °C at %d m).", shallow, min(depths), deep, max(depths)),
      "\nSource: CMAR Coastal Monitoring Program, via TidyTuesday 2026-03-31. Open Government Licence – Nova Scotia.")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.key.height = unit(1.6, "cm"),
        plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 11),
        plot.title.position = "plot", plot.caption.position = "plot")

ggsave("plot.png", p, width = 1400, height = 900, units = "px", dpi = 110, bg = "white")
ggsave("plot.svg", p, width = 1400 / 110, height = 900 / 110, bg = "white")
EOF
render plot.R

content.text:
I made `plot.R`, a heatmap with one row per depth (2 m at the top, 40 m at the bottom) and one column per month from Feb 2018 to Dec 2025. Colour shows the monthly mean temperature in °C, and grey cells are months with no data. `render plot.R` runs without errors and writes `plot.png` (1400 × 900) and `plot.svg`; the only message is a note that the `curl` package is missing and R falls back to `url()`.

The main pattern: shallow water warms strongly every summer, and the seasonal swing shrinks with depth. Monthly means span 18.0 °C at 2 m but only 10.2 °C at 40 m.

The figure uses very little from ggtime. I tried ggtime's own time axis (`scale_x_mixtime`), but it failed with an error when used with tiles. So the month axis and gap filling come from tsibble (`scale_x_yearmonth`, `fill_gaps`), and ggtime is loaded but no ggtime function draws anything.

```
REPORT
deliverable: plot.R
requirements:
  R1: done - daily means averaged per month and depth (dplyr + tsibble yearmonth), shown as a heatmap of month × depth
  R2: done - full monthly axis from 2018 Feb to 2025 Dec, made with tsibble fill_gaps(.full = TRUE)
  R3: done - months with no data are explicit NA and drawn as grey cells, not interpolated
  R4: done - y axis labelled by depth, 2 m at top through 40 m at bottom
  R5: done - colour legend "Monthly mean temperature (°C)"
  R6: done - title plus a one-sentence caption whose seasonal ranges are computed from the data
assumptions:
  - "Monthly mean" = unweighted mean of the daily means in that month (not weighted by n_obs)
  - Any month with at least one day of data gets a value, even if few days are covered
limitations:
  - ggtime::scale_x_mixtime fails with geom_tile (vctrs "Can't merge the outer name x" error), so the axis is tsibble::scale_x_yearmonth; ggtime is loaded but draws no layer or scale
  - Months with only a few days of data look the same as fully covered months
  - Depth rows are evenly spaced, not to scale in metres
```
